headline: EC proposes barring dual citizens and loan defaulters from local polls
summary: The Election Commission has recommended tougher eligibility rules for local government elections, including disqualifying MPO-listed teachers and utility bill defaulters.
details: The Election Commission (EC) has finalised recommendations to amend laws for five tiers of local government: union parishads, municipalities, upazila parishads, city corporations, and zila parishads.
Key proposals include disqualifying dual citizens, MPO-listed teachers, loan defaulters, and guarantors of loan defaulters from contesting in local elections.
The EC also recommends barring individuals who have unpaid electricity, water bills, or land tax dues, as well as those holding offices of profit.
In a move to strengthen security, the commission proposes incorporating the armed forces into the legal definition of law enforcement agencies for local polls.
Further recommendations include disqualifying individuals charge-sheeted by the International Crimes Tribunal and requiring NID cards to be renewed every 15 years.
EC Senior Secretary Akhtar Ahmed stated that these proposals will be sent to the Local Government Division for consideration and potential implementation.
While preparations for the elections are underway, the EC noted that the schedule for the polls has not yet been finalised or discussed with the government.
caption:
Dual citizens and loan defaulters could soon be barred from contesting local elections in Bangladesh.

The Election Commission (EC) has finalised recommendations to amend laws for five tiers of local government: union parishads, municipalities, upazila parishads, city corporations, and zila parishads.

Key proposals include disqualifying dual citizens, MPO-listed teachers, loan defaulters, and guarantors of loan defaulters from contesting in local elections.

The EC also recommends barring individuals who have unpaid electricity, water bills, or land tax dues, as well as those holding offices of profit.

In a move to strengthen security, the commission proposes incorporating the armed forces into the legal definition of law enforcement agencies for local polls.

Further recommendations include disqualifying individuals charge-sheeted by the International Crimes Tribunal and requiring NID cards to be renewed every 15 years.

EC Senior Secretary Akhtar Ahmed stated that these proposals will be sent to the Local Government Division for consideration and potential implementation.

While preparations for the elections are underway, the EC noted that the schedule for the polls has not yet been finalised or discussed with the government.

headline_marked: Tragedy in Barishal: [[University student found dead]] in mess room
headline: Tragedy in Barishal: University student found dead in mess room
summary: A student of Barishal University was found hanging in his locked room at a mess, sparking grief among peers and family.
details: A student of Barishal University was found dead in his locked room at a mess in Barishal. The body was found hanging, according to reports.
The discovery was made after the student had been missing or unresponsive for some time, leading others to discover the body inside the closed room.
Local authorities have been informed and the body has been recovered from the scene.
The motive behind the act remains unknown, and further investigations are underway to determine the cause of death.
caption:
